title.narrative: Climate Smart Agricultural Productivity Project(CS APP)

description.narrative: This support is within the overall AgriFI (Kenya (AgriFI): Support to productive, adapted and market integrated smallholder agriculture, including a contribution to the Africa Investment Facility: Support to the agricultural sector in Kenya.This action seeks to support KALROs research on climate smart agricultural technologies. The grant will build on two result areas; Up-scaling the past innovations that KALRO has developed and validated by sub-granting private sector organisations vide Call for Proposals amounting to a maximum of 3m euros. KALRO will be the fund manager for the sub-grants with a PCU based at their headquarters. Support to KALRO to undertake innovative research to offer solutions for identified challenges for several value chains amounting to 2M euros.
